subject: Air freight quote request to ATL
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote an all-in price in EUR for an air freight shipment of machine parts to ATL (Atlanta, US)? The shipment consists of 11 pieces, with a gross weight of 585 kg and a volume of 5.01 cbm.

The goods will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-23 at our site in 40043 Duesseldorf, Germany. Please arrange the truck pickup and transport to the departure airport and include both in your quote.

The goods must arrive at ATL no later than 2026-11-27. Among the options that meet this deadline, we will make our decision based on price.

Please confirm the planned arrival date when you send your quote.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm
